notes.title: Hotfix: v0.3.2
notes.notes: [h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]3-Star Modern Archery now works as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where using the enchanter or Master Alderos option would not properly combine items into 2-star.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where multiple Conjure Spear / Anvil etc. would not properly triple items when spawning many of the same one.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where 3-Star Dark Orb would trigger from inventory.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix: v0.3.1
notes.notes: [h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where picking "Upgrade" option from enchanter (Day 6) would not upgrade the item and could cause you to not receive a chest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Brass Knife bug where it gave more gold than it said when upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the in-game version tag.[/p][/*][*][p]Astral Hammer's cooldown is now properly set at Start of Combat.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix: v0.2.9.3.1
notes.notes: [h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when tripling Flamy War Axe,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo on tripled Blazing Bull,[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer use the space hotkey while holding LMB.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.9.3
notes.notes: [h3]v0.2.9.3[/h3][p][/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a typo when hovering the Sage encounter[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when trying to sell items with the quick-sell S+RMB hotkey during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer accidentally press an encounter option while discovering an item from a chest. (Thx Jeff)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balance:[/h3][p][b]🟢[/b]Jade (Common): Now Elven | 4.3s CD --> 4s CD[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Flare (Common): 4.3s CD --> 4s CD[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Petal Staff (Common): 4s CD --> 3.8s CD[/p][p]🟡Blazing Bull (Epic): Ability --> "When you apply burn, gain that much bonus shield" | 3.3s CD --> 3.6s CD.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]How to Grow (Rare): 5.5s CD --> 5.3s CD.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Flamy War Axe (Legendary): 8 burn --> 9 burn.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Cutlass (Legendary): 55 gold --> 45 gold. | Ability: "When you gain gold during combat, permanently gain that much damage."[/p][p][/p][h3]Other:[/h3][list][*][p]Anvil now got the "Cursed Garnet" treatment and will spawn swords very fast if it has queued up more than 5 swords.[/p][/*][*][p]The S + RMB quick-sell hotkey now also applies to triple chests. Rare chests sell for 15, Epic sell for 20 and legendary for 25 gold.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a way to manually select server in the settings. Only use US/EU unless you are based in China.[/p][/*][*][p]Restoration (Priest encounter option) changed to: Increase your max hp by +75%. The intention of this is making early leveling a viable strategy. This percentage increase might not be enough, but it will be a step in the right direction.[/p][/*][*][p]Right option from Miriel now revives you with 2 lives. This means that you can get up to 4 lives even if you die before the Cleric encounter on day 8.[/p][/*][*][p]The heart icon at the top will now turn into a skull icon if the next loss is going to end your run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.9.2
notes.notes: [h3]v0.2.9.2[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Miriel XP option now gives 16 XP (divisible by 4).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a game crash happening if Wild Magic and Absolute Zero happened in the same fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Tried a fix for an issue causing duplicates of items to be uploaded to the build pool in early rounds. Will have to wait and see if this issue is resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Life Essence would cap the enemy health at 15000.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option in settings to disable hotkeys.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new hotkey: Hold S and right-click on items to quick-sell.[/p][/*][*][p]Cursed Garnet and Conjure Spear will now trigger 5 times faster in the shop if they accumulated more than 5 triggers.[/p][/*][*][p]The new max-health system from leveling has been slightly improved. The hard diminish in health gain after 15K has been slightly reduced. After reaching 15K health you will now gain 850 max HP slowly ramping down to a minimum of 450 per level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the max hp gained from Life Essence would persists between fights against The Oak. (After your run)[/p][/*][*][p]Icicle removed from the Tailored build lucky shop from Carmen.[/p][p][/p][h3]Balance:[/h3][p][b]🟢[/b]Cursed Tiara (Cursed): 2.3s CD --> 2.6s CD | 1 bleed --> 2 bleed.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Cursed Shield (Cursed): 3.8s CD --> 3.6s CD [i]//dev comment: Hopefully these 2 cursed items will be worth picking up now :P[/i][/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Bat Wing (Legendary): 5.7s CD --> 5.4s CD.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added a new lucky reroll to Carmen:[/p][p]"Shop only contains Essences."[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.9.1
notes.notes: [h3]v0.2.9.1 - Hotfix[/h3][list][*][p]Icicle removed from the game. The Frozen Orb + Icicle combo had unforeseen strong synergy. The item will likely return in the future as a changed and event-exclusive item.[/p][/*][*][p]The improved matchmaking has been slightly changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a game crash,[/p][/*][*][p]Tome of Blades now light green with the number at 3 daggers (rather than 4),[/p][/*][*][p]Health diminish per level is now much greater after reaching 15K health.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game would show "Average enemy rating: 0" for grandmaster players.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.8.2.1
notes.notes: [h3]Small balance:[/h3][p]🔴Fire Mace (Epic): 10 burn --> 8 burn.[/p][p]🔴Regular Bow (Common): 35% crit --> 30% crit.[/p][p]🟢Modern Archery (Rare): 17s cooldown --> 16s cooldown.[/p][p]🟢Cursed Shield (Cursed): 15 shield --> 20 shield.[/p][p]🟢Shardfang (Legendary): 55 gold --> 50 gold.[/p][p]🔴Flamy War Axe (Legendary): 10 burn --> 8 burn.[/p][p]🟢Jade (Common): 4.5s cooldown --> 4.3s cooldown.[/p][p]🟢Flare (Common): 4.5s cooldown --> 4.3s cooldown.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Mythic Rod and Trigem's visual indicators now work properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo on Twilight's Edge.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.8.2
notes.notes: [h2][b]Greetings, Oaklings. Back with another update![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Thank you for the amazing feedback on dual-encounters.[/p][p]Because of the positive response, I went ahead and added tooltips for all encounters when hovering them![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance:[/b][/h3][p][b]🟢[/b]Cursed Tiara (Cursed): 2.9s cooldown --> 2.6s cooldown.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Cursed Shield (Cursed): 4.5s cooldown --> 4s cooldown.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]How to Grow (Rare): 5.7s cooldown --> 5.5s cooldown.[/p][p]🟡Refined Bow (Epic): 25 damage --> 30 damage | 30% crit chance --> 20% crit chance.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Molten Bow (Rare): 4.1s cooldown --> 4s cooldown.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Frostbound (Legendary): 20 damage --> 30 damage.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Chopper (Common): "Start of combat: Give your axes +3 damage permanently." --> "+4 damage permanently."[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Woodchopping (Epic): 5s cooldown --> 4.5s cooldown.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Sword Techniques (Rare): 5.6s cooldown --> 5.5s cooldown.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Arcane Orb (Epic): 7s cooldown --> 6.2s cooldown.[/p][p]🔴Shardfang (Legendary): Now states "This can't get bleed".[/p][p]🟡Poison Dagger (Rare): 4 poison --> 3 poison | 40 gold --> 35 gold.[/p][p]🟡Regular Bow (Common): 7 damage | 3s cooldown | 35% crit | 1 multicast[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Mythic Rod (Epic): Ability --> "On trigger: Permanently gain +7 DMG if you have only unique item types."[/p][p][/p][h3][b]General buff to Mythic Rod + Trigem:[/b][/h3][p]The "Unique item types" now only refers to "Elven", "Crystal", "Dark" etc.[/p][p]This means that you can have a Trigem build with 5 different bows, as long as they don't share the same type.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Other:[/b][/h3][p][b]🔸[/b]Using Potion of Appearance on an item of rarity "Special", "Forged" and other unique rarities will add them to the Epic item pool.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Added a new reroll to Carmen's Lucky Rerolls: "Shop contains a Cursed Item."[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Added a new QoL feature: Hover the Train button to see exactly how much gold you need to level-up![/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Added a special storyline when gifting King Midas a Doom Guide and a Cursed Necklace.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Added "Cursed" as an item rarity.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3][p][b]🔸[/b]If you lost connection and pressed "Retry", the game would only fetch bronze builds for the rest of the session.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Enemy rating was accidentally showing 100 less than what it actually was.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Petal staff has been added to the item library (accessible from the menu).[/p][p][/p][p]Remember that the PvP environment will need appx. 1-2 hours to adjust for the new balance changes.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm cooking.[/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Post-update patch: v0.2.8.1
notes.notes: [p][b]Post-update patch.[/b][/p][p]Thank you for the amazing feedback on the dual-encounters.[/p][p][/p][p]🔸 Bugfix: The Pyramid (Cursed item) gave debuffs twice by accident.[/p][p]🔸 Cursed Shield (Cursed Item) buffed: 10 shield --> 15 shield.[/p][p]🔸 After gathering feedback the bleed cap was removed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance tweaks:[/b][/p][p]🟢 Heavy Armor (encounter option from Blacksmith): Start each fight with 150 shield --> 200 shield.[/p][p]🟢 Cutlass (Legendary): 2.9s cooldown --> 2.7s cooldown.[/p][p]🟢 Batwing (Legendary): 5.8s cooldown --> 5.7s cooldown.[/p][p]🟢 Twillight's Edge (Common): Start of Combat: Permanently gain +5 damage --> +7 damage.[/p][p]🟢 Hunter's Tome (Rare): 3.1s cooldown --> 3s cooldown.[/p][p]🟢 Cobalt Spear (Legendary) 3.3s cooldown --> 3.2s cooldown.[/p][p]🟢 Chopper (Common): 3.6s cooldown --> 3.4s cooldown.[/p][p]🟢 Arcane Orb (Epic): 7.2s cooldown --> 7s cooldown.[/p][p]🟢 Flare (Common): 4.8s cooldown --> 4.5s cooldown.[/p][p]🔴 Blazing Bull (Epic): 3.2s cooldown --> 3.3s cooldown.[/p][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.7.4
notes.notes: [h3]Patch v0.2.7.4[/h3][p][/p][h3]Balance:[/h3][p][i]//Dev comment: 15 gold items generally provided a pretty huge amount of tempo and are being nerfed to open up for more early strategies.[/i][/p][p]🔴 Novice Blade (Common): 20 damage --> 15 damage.[/p][p]🔴 Bone Club (Common): 35 damage --> 25 damage.[/p][p]🔴 Regular Bow (Common): 15 damage --> 10 damage.[/p][p]🔴 Refined Spear (Common): 2.2s cooldown --> 2.3s cooldown.[/p][p][/p][p]🔴 Emerald Sword (Legendary): 40 gold --> 45 gold | 2.1s cooldown --> 2.3s cooldown.[/p][p]🔴 Shardfang (Legendary): 45 gold --> 55 gold[/p][p]🟢 Fire Orb (Epic): 6s cooldown --> 5s cooldown.[/p][p][/p][h3]Encounters:[/h3][p]🟢 Take My Bow (Elven Archer, day 6): Gain a Regular Bow with "Elven" and +4 multicast --> +5 multicast.[/p][p][/p][h3]Other:[/h3][p]🔸 The word "permanently" was added to Executioner's text.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed a crash when you lucky rolled into "shop only contains items you own" but you owned 0 items.[/p][p]🔸 Value Potion and Royal Drops can no longer be used on an item being discovered from a triple chest.[/p][p][/p][p]Great things are in the works - hang tight[/p][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.7.3
notes.notes: [h3]Patch v0.2.7.2[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Balance:[/b][/p][p]🟢Executioner: 40% crit --> 10% crit | Ability --> "Start of Combat: Gain +30% crit chance."[/p][p]🔴Sage left option: Sacred Touch --> Make an item Holy (drag item here)[/p][p]🔴Lyra left option: Northern Blessing --> Gain a Frozen Orb and make an item Frosty (drag item here)[/p][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.7.2
notes.notes: [h3]Patch v0.2.7.2[/h3][p][/p][p][b]The matchmaking system has now been enabled![/b][/p][p]In ranked, you will only be matched against people in your matchmaking bucket:[/p][p]🔸 Bronze + Silver[/p][p]🔸 Gold + Emerald + Diamond + Master[/p][p]🔸 Grandmaster[/p][p][/p][p]You can now hover your opponent's avatar to see their Rating, Lives and Trophies.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance:[/b][/p][p]🟢 Master Alderos (Day 9): Gain a level and 15 gold --> 20 gold | Upgrade an epic item --> Upgrade an epic item and gain 15 gold.[/p][p]🔴 Lyra (Day 9) Northern Offering: Gain 2x frost essence --> Gain 1x Frost Essence and a Frozen Orb.[/p][p]🔴 Bulwark (Rare): 3.4s cooldown --> 3.6s cooldown.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]🔸Fixed the placement of enemy encounter history.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix: v0.2.7.1
notes.notes: [h3]Hotfix v0.2.7.1[/h3][p]🔸 Added more King Midas interactions with "Make an Offering", and fixed a bug where you didn't get anything by offering him a home-brew.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed a bug where you could accidentally buy an item in the shop by clicking on a triple reward.[/p][p]🔸 "Freerolls" option by Traveller now says: +2 free rerolls, and +2 each day.[/p]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3692220/Oaken_Tower_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]New:[/h3][p][b]Morph Potion[/b] [b](20g)[/b]: Transform an item into another random item.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/aea1029bf85de1dc07bdad636eb67efa9ed80d4e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Morph Vial[/b] [b](8g):[/b] Transform an item into another random item of the same rarity.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/eee7ff9805a4f838ed479da0d932b9fe1c4a8574.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance:[/b][/h3][p]🔴 Prices of Burn/Bleed/Poison potions generally increased.[/p][p]🔴 The "Treasure Vault" lucky reroll from Carmen has been moved over to the slightly more unlikely bucket (60% / 40%)[/p][p]🟢 Walk on Water (Carmen, day9): +1000 max hp --> +1300 max hp.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3][p]🔸Fixed the Goblet sound effect to match the volume of the rest.[/p][p]🔸Healer's Oath text specification: "When another item heals".[/p][p]🔸Fixed game crash when creating infinite loops of items triggering each other.[/p][p]🔸If you gift King Midas a goblet, the new Goblet effect will now be stated on the Goblet infobox[/p][p][/p][p]  [b]//Bocary[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.5.2 | New day 9 encounter
notes.notes: [h1]Patch v0.2.5.2[/h1][h3]Greetings, Oaklings. Back with yet another update![/h3][p][/p][p][b]New day 9 encounter: Potion Market.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/fc2bb1c5f12bd88898627cb6065342e8f72409b0.png"][/img][/p][p]The potion market is a unique encounter that doesn't feature 2 different choices, instead you will enter a shop with only potions where you can reroll as normal.[/p][p]After the potion shop you will enter the regular shop.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance:[/b][/p][p][b]🟢Crescentshot (Rare):[/b] 10 damage --> 8 damage | 2 multicast --> 3 multicast | 3.5s cooldown --> 3.4s cooldown.[/p][p][b]🟢Lunar Codex (Rare):[/b] 3.4s cooldown --> 3.3s cooldown.[/p][p][b]🟢Tome of Blades (Rare):[/b] 2.5s cooldown --> 2.4s cooldown | If you have at least 4 daggers, gain +4 bonus multicast --> at least 3 daggers.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Some mistakes in the item library screen has been fixed.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Crystal Flare had no business being crystal. It is now called Flare and is only Artifact/Flame.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]The "Inventory" text in the bottom no longer stays on top of the infoboxes of potions.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]The "Potion Shop" lucky reroll from Carmen didn't give any of the new potions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.5
notes.notes: [h1]Patch v0.2.5[/h1][h3]Greetings, Oaklings[/h3][p][/p][p][b]🔸Item library added to the game![/b][/p][p][b]🔸29 new potions added to the game.[/b][/p][p]In the future, it will be easier to obtain potions through the upcoming Witch items. For now, it is only from certain encounters.[/p][p][b]🔸When you discover an item, you can now see the sell price of each item.[/b][/p][p][b]🔸If you already have 1 of an item in the shop, it will light up green.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance:[/b][/p][p]🟡[b]Dagger Manual[/b] has been completely reworked and is now called Tome of Blades. [/p][p]Rare | 40 gold | 15 DMG | 30% crit | 2.5s cooldown | "Start of Combat: If you have at least 4 daggers, gain +4 bonus multicast.". [i]//Dev comment: The old dagger manual was too limiting in future item design. This rework spawns the new midgame dagger tempo build.[/i][/p][p][b]🔴Value Potion:[/b] 15 gold --> 25 gold.[/p][p][b]🔴Midas Diary (Epic):[/b] 40 gold --> 50 gold.[/p][p][b]🟢Topaz Spear (Epic):[/b] 8 bleed --> 10 bleed | 5.2s cooldown --> 5s cooldown | 45 gold --> 40 gold.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Encounters:[/b][/p][p][b]🟢Shieldbearer:[/b] Both options buffed.[/p][p][b]🟢Salesman discount license[/b] (right option): gain 10 gold --> 15 gold.[/p][p][b]🟢Carmen - Walk on Water:[/b] Gain +800 health --> gain +1000 health.[/p][p][b]🟢[/b]Added a new lucky roll for Carmen.[/p][p][b]🟢"Regular Stock" from potion seller[/b] now has 2 additional weapon-buff potions that can be gained.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other:[/b][/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Added a sound cue for when reroll price goes up.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Reroll price increase now happens after 15 rolls instead of 10, but the increase is increased from +1 --> +2.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Potions now show a "Sale!" sign if they are on sale.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Venom Flask now correctly says "+2 poison" in its infobox.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Fixed a visual bug with chest rewards in the battle against The Oak.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Life Essence was accidentally removed from the item pool and has been re-added.[/p][p][b]🔸[/b]Fixed a bug where you could sell an item without losing it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.4.6
notes.notes: [h3]Patch v0.2.4.6[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Been hard at work on full release, but here's some more stuff:[/b][/p][p][b]🔸 [/b]Added a "Forged" rarity type for the forged blades.[/p][p]🔸 Fixed a bug where using a value potion on a potion that you had 2 of would crash the game.[/p][p]🔸 An [b]Anti-Cheat[/b] system has been implemented for the game.[/p][p][b]🔸 [/b]Players in Casual no longer upload builds to the build-pool.[/p][p][b]🔸 [/b]After rerolling 10 times in one day, reroll price will ramp up with +1 :3gold:  cost per roll.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Encounters:[/b][/h3][p][b]Elven Favor (Day 6)[/b]: No longer grants +10 gold.[/p][p][b]Walk on Water (Day 9): [/b]gain +800 max hp --> gain +1000 max hp.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance:[/b][/h3][p][b]🔴  Wardbinder (Epic): [/b]"On trigger: Trigger your shields." --> "On trigger: Trigger adjacent shields."[/p][p][b]🔴 Hook (Rare):[/b] 25% crit --> 20% crit.[/p][p][b]🟢  Life Essence (Epic): [/b]0% crit --> 25% crit | Life essence's ability can now crit for twice the max health![/p][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p]

notes.notes: [h3]v0.2.4.5 - Small patch[/h3][p][/p][h3]Dark buff:[/h3][p]🟢[b]Eclipse:[/b]  Rare | 35 gold | 20 dmg | 2.6s cooldown | "Start of combat: Permanently gain +4 damage per dark item."[/p][p]🟢[b]Cursed Necklace: [/b]Epic | 45 gold | 0 dmg | 9s cooldown | "On trigger: Trigger your items Start of Combat effects."[/p][p]🟢[b]Executioner[/b]: 70 damage --> 80 damage.[/p][p]🟢[b]Moonstone[/b]: 35 gold --> 30 gold. | 2.9s cooldown --> 2.8s cooldown.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fix:[/b][/p][p]Cutlass said "+8" even though it got +10 dmg per sell.[/p][p][/p][p][b]//Bocary[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.4
notes.notes:
[h1]🪵🪵Greetings, Oaklings🪵🪵[/h1][p][/p][p][b]New day 9 encounter: Carmen[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/5885363367efc29993e06b0c290fbd57d326ebc5.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Option 1:[/b] Walk on Water.[/h3][p]                    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/23996e5459d65d00359633843519ab55f0d5c6a7.png"][/img][/p][p]Gain +750 max health and increase your health cap to [b]20.000[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Option 2:[/b] Lucky Rerolls.[/h3][p]                    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/86863bca94be779597da44b2058391ee2363c1e1.png"][/img][/p][p]This option gives your rerolls a 25% chance to become "lucky".[/p][p][b]Examples are: "A random item is free"[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/f7ee0562e927a15380b940fe67773a27399299e7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]and: Shop only contains potions (including brand new potions).[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/e60b6fc66706c39874cdbe184c5c4f23a0f913d1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]and: Shop contains a random tailored build.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/b602eeab3abc9c1373bc702f10d64edc73c05c54.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Quality of Life feature:[/h3][p]If you lose connection during a run, the game will prompt you with a "Reconnect" button.[/p][p]The reconnect button will always appear if you lose connection, and you can keep reconnecting even if you lose connection many times during a run.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Balance:[/h3][p]🔴[b]Amethyst Bow:[/b] Common --> Rare | 25 gold --> 35 gold.[/p][p]🟡[b]Ruby Knife:[/b] Rare --> Common | 35 gold --> 30 gold | 3.7s cooldown --> 3.4s cooldown | 3 bleed --> 2 bleed.[/p][p]🔴[b]Elven Shield (Common):[/b] 25 gold --> 30 gold.[/p][p]🟢[b]Molten Bow (Rare):[/b] 4.2s cooldown --> 4.1s cooldown.[/p][p]🟢[b]Refined Bow (Epic):[/b] 20 damage --> 25 damage | "Has +1 multicast per other Elven item." --> "Has +1 multicast per Elven item." | 1 multicast --> 0 multicast. [i]//Dev comment: The ability rephrase simply means that it will count itself in the multicast bonus. Therefore, the base multicast was removed. The only real difference from before is that it will now also count other refined bows in the multicast bonus - making it slightly better.[/i][/p][p]🟢[b]Life Essence (Epic):[/b] 0 heal --> 50 heal. [i]//Dev comment: instead of just giving +50 max hp, life essence now also heals you for 50, giving it more value in-combat.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]
[b]JOIN THE DISCORD:[/b] https://discord.com/invite/SFruNNHWbH

[b]//Bocary[/b]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]🪵🪵Greetings, Oaklings🪵🪵[/h1]

[b]Please wishlist the game[/b] ❤️🪵
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400960/Oaken_Tower/

[b]New day 6 encounter: Salesman[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/1ef89c86e06f375cda999d883c0211f77083ffdf.png[/img]

[b]One of the options from the Salesman will give you discounts![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/389280b2c5aece49e73056efcee9f4c6c0d534cd.png[/img]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
🟢[b]Healing Word (Common):[/b] 5 heal --> 10 heal
🟢[b]Void Stinger (Legendary):[/b] 0 burn --> 2 burn | 0 bleed --> 2 bleed | 0 poison --> 2 poison | 40 gold --> 50 gold | Text rephrased to: "When you apply a debuff, permanently gain +2 damage."
🟢[b]Runic Shield (Epic):[/b] 10 heal --> 0 heal | 0 multicast --> +1 multicast [i]//Dev comment: This makes Runic Shield perfect in a Warrior Shield build, or a Void Stinger build.[/i]
🟢[b]Voidspike (Common):[/b] Text rephrased to: "When you apply a debuff, gain +2 bonus damage." | 30 gold --> 25 gold | 15 damage --> 18 damage.
🟢[b]Cobalt Spear (Legendary):[/b] The word "Permanently" added to its text. | 30 damage --> 35 damage | 4.2s cooldown --> 4.1s cooldown. | Quality of Life: Cobalt Spear will now trigger AFTER your other items' start of combat effects, meaning Trident and Nightfall will apply their SoC effects before getting consumed.
🟢[b]Warrior Shield (Legendary):[/b] 3s cooldown --> 2.8s cooldown | 80 shield --> 100 shield.
🟢[b]Decay (Epic):[/b] 3s cooldown --> 2.4s cooldown.
🟡[b]Elvish Orb (Epic):[/b] Gained the Elven tag. Text adjusted to: "On trigger: Give elven item above +1 multicast permanently (Except Elvish Orb)."
🔴[b]Lost Fragment (Legendary): [/b]65 gold --> 60 gold | 5.8s cooldown --> 4s cooldown | Ability changed to: "On trigger: Give item above +1 bonus multicast and increase this item's cooldown by 4s."
🟢[b]Hunters Tome (Rare):[/b] 3.4s cooldown --> 3.3s cooldown.
🟢[b]Venom Ring (Legendary):[/b] 5.5s cooldown --> 5s cooldown.
🟢[b]Life Essence (Epic):[/b] 4.1s cooldown --> 3.9s cooldown.
🟢[b]Shardfang (Legendary):[/b] 1.4s cooldown --> 1.2s cooldown | 15 damage --> 25 damage | 55 gold --> 45 gold.
🟢[b]Redemption (Legendary):[/b] 4.2s cooldown --> 4s cooldown | 10 damage --> 25 damage | 55 gold --> 50 gold | 100 heal --> 120 heal.
🟢[b]Doom Guide (Legendary):[/b] 1500 damage --> 2000 damage.
🟢[b]Woodchopping (Epic):[/b] "On trigger: Give all axes +5 damage permanently." --> "On trigger: Give all axes +7 damage permanently."
🟢[b]Arcane Cleaver (Rare):[/b] 4.3s cooldown --> 3.9s cooldown
🔴[b]Emerald Sword (Legendary):[/b] 5.7s cooldown --> 4.1s cooldown | 10 damage --> 30 damage | 2 bleed --> 5 bleed | Ability changed to: "When you apply bleed, gain +1 bonus bleed."
🟢[b]Holy Sigil (Epic):[/b] 4.4s cooldown --> 4.2s cooldown | 30 heal --> 40 heal.

[h3]Moon items rework and more refined direction: Focus on Multicast.[/h3]
🟡[b]Lunar Codex (Rare):[/b] Ability changed to: "When you level up, permanently gain +1 multicast." [i]//Dev comment: My personal favourite change. Not only does this comply with the new moon archetype, but it is also an elegant buff to Arcane Secrets (Legendary).[/i]
🟡[b]Moon Knife (Rare):[/b] 15% crit --> 0% crit | 0 multicast --> 1 multicast | 12 damage --> 10 damage. | 2.1s cooldown --> 2.5s cooldown.
🟡[b]Lapis Lazuli (Epic):[/b] 0 multicast --> 1 multicast | Ability changed to: "On trigger: Permanently give your other moon items +2 damage." | 3.4s cooldown --> 5s cooldown. //Dev comment: A great support item that ties the moon build together. The new Lapis also provides a new source of getting damage on Astral Hammer in a mace build.
🟡[b]Moonveil (Legendary):[/b] Ability changed to: "Start of Combat: Give your moon items +1 bonus multicast." | 6.7s cooldown --> 4.2s cooldown. | 1 multicast --> 2 multicast.
🟢[b]Crescentshot (Rare):[/b] 3.7s cooldown --> 3.5 cooldown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/c72789a6eef26b3de22e575e1b3d3131bce7a374.png[/img]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Frozen Orb no longer activates frosty items outside of the tower.
[*]Glacier and a few other items no longer get buffs from outside combat.
[*]The ability text of items was not always in the intended spot on the infobox.
[*]Sometimes, all items would not be uploaded to the database from your build. This bug has been fixed.
[*]Chests gained from events now correctly spawn all the way to the right.
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Directional arrows of items now show in the end screen as well.
[*]The victory/defeat text after battle will now stay behind item infoboxes.
[/list]

Remember that the PvP environment might still contain old / unnerfed builds for an hour or two.

[b]JOIN THE DISCORD:[/b] https://discord.com/invite/SFruNNHWbH

[b]//Bocary[/b]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.1.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, Oaklings[/h1]

[b]Please wishlist the game[/b] ❤️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400960/Oaken_Tower/

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*]🟢Warrior Shield (Legendary): 45 damage when you shield --> 50 damage when you shield | 70 shield --> 80 shield | 3.5s cooldown --> 3s cooldown.
[*]🟢Cobalt Spear (Legendary): 4.5s cooldown --> 4.2s cooldown.
[*]🔴Emerald Sword (Legendary): 5.5s cooldown --> 5.7s cooldown | 20 damage --> 10 damage | No longer Elven.
[*]🔴Amber (Epic): 3.5s cooldown --> 3.7s cooldown.
[*]🟢Venom Ring (Legendary): 5.8s cooldown --> 5.5s cooldown | Now has the Elven tag.
[*]🟢Protector (Legendary): 30 shield --> 50 shield | "On trigger: remove 8 burn, 5 poison and 3 bleed." --> "On trigger: remove 20% of your debuffs." | 20 heal --> 30 heal. | 60 gold --> 50 gold.
[*]🟢Redemption (Legendary): 4.4s cooldown --> 4.2s cooldown | 25 heal --> 100 heal.
[*]🟢Flamy War Axe (Legendary): 12 burn --> 15 burn. | Ability rephrased, now keeps the optained bonus damage throughout the combat.
[*]🟢Executioner (Epic): 50 gold --> 40 gold | 80 damage --> 70 damage | 0% crit --> 40% crit
[*]🔴Lost Fragment (Legendary): 5.3s cooldown --> 5.8s cooldown.
[*]🟢Frozen Orb (Epic): 7.4s cooldown --> 7.1s cooldown.
[*]🟢High Blade (Epic): 5s cooldown --> 4.8s cooldown | 25 damage --> 30 damage.
[*]🟡Mace Study (Rare): 5.8s cooldown --> 6s cooldown | "On trigger: Give adjacent maces +2 damage permanently." --> "On trigger: Give mace below +4 damage permanently."
[*]🔴Darksteel (Common): 80% crit --> 75% crit.
[*]🔴Bone Club (Common): 3s cooldown --> 3.2s cooldown.
[/list]

[h3]Encounters:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Elven Archer: "Take my bow" now gives an elven regular bow with +3 multicast instead of +2.
[*]Blacksmith: "Heavy Armor" 120 shield --> 130 shield.
[*]Shieldbearer: "Dark Path" option removed and replaced with: "Shield Mastery: Give a shield +1 multicast".
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Triple chests now appear on the far right of the inventory, while items does not appear in this spot.
[*]Trigem and Mythic Rod now has a green/red indicator showing if you have only unique item types or not. Their ability texts slightly rephrased.
[*]Directional arrow indicators made brighter.
[*]Now shows a gold icon instead of "$" at the reroll button.
[*]Leaving or losing connection mid-game no longer removes a flat 100 rating, but rather calculates your rating gain/loss based on trophies. I.e. leaving with 5 trophies result in no rating change.
[*]Time Tonic encounter now states what Time Tonic actually does.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed the "Dark" tag from Coldshot, which had been added by mistake.
[*]Coldshot and Midas Diary no longer work from inventory during combat.
[*]Cobalt Spear now correctly consumes bleed as well.
[*]"Heavy Armor" and Dusk Shield now trigger Warrior Shield damage on start of combat shielding.
[*]Pausing and then entering a new screen (like the combat screen) before unpausing no longer causes bugs.
[*]Projectiles no longer slow down a lot when playing with 60/90 FPS.
[*]The Elven tag and other added tags to items will now properly work on enemy items.
[/list]

Remember that the PvP environment might still contain old / unnerfed builds for an hour or two.

[b]JOIN THE DISCORD:[/b] https://discord.com/invite/SFruNNHWbH

[b]//Bocary[/b]

notes.title: Balance Patch: 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Oaklings[/h1]

[b]Thank you for a successful launch of the Oaken Tower Demo![/b]

Following the demo launch, there has been a bunch of feedback, so here's a balance patch as well as some fixes!

[h2]Balance changes:[/h2]
🟢Warhorn (Legendary): $60 --> $55 | 12s cooldown --> 10s cooldown
🔴Redemption (Legendary): 3.5s cooldown --> 4.2s cooldown
🟢Astral Hammer (Legendary): $70 --> $60
🟢Cursed Necklace (Legendary): $75 --> $55
🔴Life Essence (Rare): 4s cooldown --> 5s cooldown
🔴Natures Call (Epic): $55 --> $60
🟡Lost Fragment (Legendary): Ability changed to: "On trigger: Give item above +1 bonus multicast (except Lost Fragment)." | 5s cooldown. | $60.
🔴Moonveil (Legendary): 5.3s cooldown --> 6.8s cooldown
🔴Lapis Lazuli (Epic): $45 --> $60 | 15s cooldown --> 15.5s cooldown
🟢Conjure Spear (Epic): 12s cooldown --> 11s cooldown
🟢Woodchopping (Epic): 13s cooldown --> 10s cooldown
🟢Arcane Secrets (Legendary): "When a magic item triggers, permanently gain +1 damage." --> "When a magic item triggers, permanently gain +2 damage." | 3.2s cooldown --> 3.7s cooldown
🔴Redemption (Legendary): 4.2s cooldown --> 4.4s cooldown | 20 damage --> 10 damage
🟢Twinfangs (Legendary): "Permanently gain +7 damage every time you buy an item." --> "Permanently gain +8 damage every time you buy an item."
🔴Dream Catcher (Rare): 5.3s cooldown --> 5.5s cooldown | $40 --> $45
🟢Decay (Epic): $45 --> $40 | 4.3s cooldown --> 3s cooldown | 35 damage --> 40 damage.
🟢High Blade (Epic): Ability changed to: "Start of combat: Permanently recude cooldown by 0.1s per Elven or Moon item."
🔴Elvish Orb (Epic): Elven/Artifact --> Artifact.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Triple Life Essence now correctly gives +50HP instead of 25.
[*]Life Essence can no longer bring you above the maximum of 10000 HP.
[*]You can no longer right-click items in fights.
[*]Elvish Orb now correctly only gives multicast to Elven items (instead of any item).
[*] Enemy Astral Hammer now correctly checks if enemy is level 8+ instead of the player.
[/list]

Check out this awesome video by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SuperAutoGaming]SuperAutoGaming[/url]
https://youtu.be/m2qnggs-uJI?si=1QspQOjmYJtMAhry

//Bocary
